meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

copy.tagline: 简化药物研发中的分子分析工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做药物研发,常需要用代码处理化学数据。
copy.tagline_en: Simplify molecular analysis in drug research and development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in drug discovery and want a friendlier way to process molecular data.

howto.what: Claude 会用 datamol 这个 Python 库处理分子:解析和标准化 SMILES、算描述符与指纹、聚类、生成 3D 构象、读写 SDF 等文件,产出的是原生 RDKit 分子对象。
howto.when: 当你要做药物发现相关的分子操作时触发,例如解析/标准化 SMILES、算描述符、聚类等;需要精细控制或自定义参数时,它建议直接用 RDKit。

howto.what_en: Claude uses datamol (Python) to process molecules: parse and standardize SMILES, compute descriptors and fingerprints, cluster, generate 3D conformers, read/write SDF files. Outputs are native RDKit Mol objects.
howto.when_en: Triggers for standard drug-discovery molecule work: parsing or standardizing SMILES, computing descriptors, clustering. For fine control or custom parameters, it points to RDKit directly.
